# Pack compatibility matrix

Generated from `core.pack.compatibility.FEATURES` (also as
[`pack-compatibility-matrix.json`](pack-compatibility-matrix.json) and from
`flyto pack matrix`). What each check means and how a pack joins the
certified list: [the adapter compatibility spec](../specs/ADAPTER_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md).

Matrix version **1** (`flyto.pack-compatibility-matrix.v1`). A cell is `yes` when that
flyto-core release accepts the feature.

| Feature | What the pack uses |
| --- | --- |
| `capability_contract.v1` | `contract` on a module row (`flyto.capability-contract.v1`) |
| `contract.optional_fields` | `role`, `artifacts`, `recovery`, `expected_duration_ms` |
| `pack.v1` | `flyto.pack.v1` manifest, `subprocess-jsonrpc` and `http` bindings |
| `evidence.absolute_targets` | `distance_to` / `angle_to` measure ops, `measure.frame` |
| `recovery.semantics` | `recovery.on` / `alternatives` / `preserves` / `resource_scope` / `fills` |
| `evidence.display_keys` | evidence `label`, `unit`, `channel` |
| `contract.resource_states` | `establishes`, `occupies` |
| `pack.connector` | `connector` section and `connector` binding (operations become modules) |
| `pack.entitlements` | `entitlements` probe and `scopes` sections (the connector pre-check) |
| `pack.standalone` | `standalone` section (runs on its own as an MCP server; portable zip) |
| `pack.upgrade` | `upgrade` section (`supersedes`, `rollback`, `migrations`) |

## Certified packs

None. Only a verified `flyto.pack-certification.v1` record adds a row here.
